name: Haus Obwaller
beschreibung: The Haus Obwaller is located at Dorf 55 in Söll within the popular Wilder Kaiser holiday region in Tyrol. The charming and comfortably furnished holiday apartments provide ample space for families and couples seeking independent, flexible mountain living. Features include fully equipped kitchens with modern appliances, welcoming living areas, separate bedrooms, and private balconies offering sweeping views of the craggy Wilder Kaiser massif and the Hohe Salve. The village centre of Söll, featuring traditional restaurants, cafés, and local shops, is just a leisurely walk away. In winter, the nearby ski bus quickly connects guests to the base terminal of the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental. In summer, themed trails like Hexenwasser and scenic valley cycling routes guarantee outdoor fun.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy holiday apartments in Söll at the Wilder Kaiser in a quiet location with fully equipped kitchens and close to the SkiWelt.
